_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Mathematics Standard (041), set 30/1/2. 27 pages: idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions + Q1; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-26, Hindi on every odd index 1-25 (each odd page is the Hindi of the page after it). The tops of all odd pages were checked on the contact sheet and open with Hindi; the last page (idx 26) is English (Q38). No parity inversion. Instruction (viii) prints the internal-choice count: 2 in B, 2 in C, 2 in D, 3 in E = 9 alternatives, all found (Q23, Q24, Q29, Q30, Q32, Q35, Q36, Q37, Q38). Decimal points on this paper are RAISED (Q11, Q37), written 1{\cdot}73. All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read off the marking scheme for 30/1/2; each was also re-derived and agrees. Sibling of 30/1/1: 41 rows are the same questions as 30/1/1 (confirmed on these pages, stem/context/options/answer/chapter/subtopic/difficulty copied byte-for-byte); 12 rows are new to this set (Q3, Q4, Q7, Q13, Q14, Q15, Q21, Q26, Q27, Q33, Q35a, Q35b). The three case studies are 30/1/1's, rotated: Case Study 1 here is 30/1/1's CS2 (brooch), CS2 is its CS3 (lighthouse), CS3 is its CS1 (charity run).

questions.context: Questions number 19 and 20 are Assertion and Reason based questions. Two statements are given, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R). Select the correct answer to these questions from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) as given below.
questions.stem:
**Assertion (A) :** If we join two hemispheres of same radius along their bases, then we get a sphere.

**Reason (R) :** Total Surface Area of a sphere of radius r is \(3\pi r^2\).

options.label: A
options.text: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).

options.label: B
options.text: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is **not** the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).

options.label: C
options.text: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.

options.label: D
options.text: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
